hypothesis: A human groups people by relevant clothing/object-part colour. Direct image colour statistics may give a more useful scene relation than source-domain neural geometry.
target_supervision: same frozen teacher CROP answers, target images and queries only; no target labels
features: mean of up to3 uniform real candidate crops, whole/upper/lower fixed regions,12x8 HS histogram plus8 V, Hellinger square root
query_parts: explicit shirt/jersey -> upper; pants/skirt -> lower; dark/light team -> upper; other colour -> whole; dynamic/spatial conjunction -> no colour cohort
baseline: Actual video-prefix MLP soft KD on exactly the same normalized PCD + parsed colour features; source logit initialization and teacher-only stopping match prior controls
geometry: equal norm source PCD and parsed colour blocks; source PCD only and colour only are separate registered geometry ablations
energy: same normalized3NN Laplacian and frozen teacher anchors as V2; unqueried unary precision0.1, queried unary removed, graph weight1
information_scope: past and current video teacher only; per-row normalization; current full video transductive
costs: record real image I/O, colour extraction, teacher-head fit and inference wall; charge these in later live end-to-end comparison
caveats: within-track ID mixtures can contaminate means
non-colour/dynamic queries fall back to matched KD
acceptance: official HOTA, original-parent intervals, same-feature trained KD, fixed-answer module ablations and CountMatched; no success assumption
